title: Voyager cup file
description: A cup: a name, a game mode and the rotation of maps it plays, in order. Describes the format the catalogue adapters in voyager-platform read. The loader does not validate against this document at runtime; the adapters are the runtime check. The map names are checked against the map files by the loader, not by this schema.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema, so editors can find it.

schemaVersion.description: The version of the file format this file is written in. Absent means 1. This schema describes version 2, the version that states a key; version 1 files are described by cup-v1.schema.json.

key.description: The cup's identifier: elytrarace:<value>, where the value is lower case letters, digits, underscores and hyphens, at most 32 characters. Operators name the cup by this key, or by its value alone.

authors.description: The players who built the cup, at most eight, none repeated. Optional. Shown as data, never translated.

displayName.description: The name players read, in place of the cup's id. Optional; absent or blank means the id. Shown as plain text, never translated.

mode.description: RACE scores and ranks; PRACTICE does not.

mapNames.description: The maps of the rotation, in the order they are played. Each must name a map file's name.

notes.description: Free text for the person editing the file. Ignored by the loader.

uuid.description: The player's UUID in the canonical 8-4-4-4-12 form, in either letter case.

name.description: The player's name, as a Minecraft username is written. Kept as written; not looked up at load.
